publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public market consensus considers Trey McBride the consensus overall TE1 in dynasty formats following his record-breaking 126-catch season in 2025 and 2026 contract extension. Travis Kelce is valued primarily as a short-term win-now rental due to his age (37) and potential retirement horizon after 2026.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: AVI and public consensus align closely on Trey McBride as a tier-one cornerstone (C-AVI 93.4, Market ~95). Travis Kelce holds respectable C-AVI (74.0) for current-season redraft/contender value, but his dynasty market value (~55) is heavily depressed relative to McBride.
relevantContext: McBride is 26 years old, signed through 2029 with Arizona, and maintains a minimum 7-catch floor per game in 2026.
Kelce is 37 years old on a 1-year deal, dealing with minor maintenance issues, and faces impending retirement.
In 16-team leagues, elite young tight ends are virtually unobtainable without paying multiple 1st-round equivalents.
